item.title: Insider: Many Around Oilers 'Not Overly Thrilled' About Paul Coffey's Return to the Bench
item.description: Many around the league will be watching the Edmonton Oilers very closely as things pick up again in the coming days. item.title: NHL Trade Rumor: One Team Drops Out of Patrik Laine Trade Talks
item.description: It's common knowledge around the NHL at this point that the Montreal Canadiens would like to move on from Patrik Laine and his $8.7 million cap hit that expires after this season. His spot in the lineup has been usurped by others over the past four months that he's been out. There have been several teams linked to the seven-time 20-goal scorer, including the Seattle Kraken, Carolina Hurricanes and others. item.description: Nazem Kadri admitted to the media this week that he has had discussions with Calgary Flames management about his future. item.title: Winnipeg Jets' 'Most Valuable Trade Chip' Named
item.description: The Winnipeg Jets unexpectedly find themselves 11 points back of a playoff spot as we head out of the Olympic break this week. item.title: NHLTR Mock Trade: St. Louis Blues trade Jordan Binnington to Montreal Canadiens
item.description: The Montreal Canadiens are looking for a veteran goaltender who has Stanley Cup Playoff experience, and currently on the trade market, there's no better option than St. Louis Blues netminder Jordan Binnington.Despite a tough start to this season on a struggling Blues squad, Binnington proved his worth at the Olympics for Team Canada, and is now certainly skyrocketing up the trade boards of onlooking teams, like the Canadiens, who are searching for an upgrade in net.Daily Faceoff's Tyler Yaremchu
